title: lathyrus luteus subsp. hispanicus
intro: Lathyrus luteus subsp. hispanicus, commonly known as the yellow vetchling or yellow pea, is a plant species in the legume family. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of protein, fiber, and minerals. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus luteus subsp. hispanicus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
